It's a Chiss charric.|Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade Skywalker, upon finding Mitth'ras'safis's charric in the remains of the Outbound Flight|<ref name="SQ" />}}
[[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]] of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]] owned<ref name="OF" /> a '''charric''' that was adorned with [[Written Cheunh|Chiss lettering]].<ref name="SQ" /> When Mitth'ras'safis boarded the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' with [[Jorj Car'das]]<ref name="OF" /> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="OF Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> he carried the weapon concealed in his tunic.<ref name="OF" /> In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="SQ Date" /> his weapon was recovered by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]].<ref name="SQ" />
